summary: No reachable vulnerabilities. Trust boundary (stored report from IndexedDB): parseLeakCounts rejects non-arrays, non-object elements, unknown or non-string categories (indexOf over the known LEAK_CATEGORIES ids only, so no prototype-key lookups), duplicates and out-of-order entries (strictly increasing index, which also caps the array at 15 elements, so no unbounded-input cost), and enforces whole-number bounds 1 <= decisions, errors <= decisions, major <= errors. A malformed report fails closed with RangeError. The bundled leak-categories.json is validated at module load (exact keys, id derived from street/facingBet/action, no duplicates, text shape). All displayed text (title, evidence, fix) comes from the shipped data file plus validated integers and is rendered as React text children, with no dangerouslySetInnerHTML or HTML sink. Regexes in the validator are linear (no nested quantifiers) and run only on the bundled file. No new dependencies, secrets, network, crypto or randomness.
